description: Unit test class for the BaseAttributeTypeValidator in the OpenMRS project, specifically testing validation logic for VisitAttributeType entities.

classes.name: BaseAttributeTypeValidatorTest

classes.name: CustomVisitAttributeTypeValidator

methods.name: before
methods.description: Setup method executed before each test to initialize validator and attributeType objects.

methods.description: Tests that validation fails when the input object is null.

methods.description: Tests that validation fails if the name field is null.

methods.name: shouldFailIfNameIsEmpty
methods.description: Tests that validation fails if the name field is an empty string.

methods.name: shouldFailIfNameIsOnlyWhitespaces
